os: macOS 26.6.2 arm64, fresh clean guest, no Prismattyc installed
proof_kind: host-built binaries copied into the guest; the app window driven by pointer and keyboard events over the VM's VNC server; the child process records its raw input to files read back over ssh; presented app window cropped
fixture: fixture-run.sh: a POSIX shell child per pane. In old mode it prints a marker and turns on mouse (1000/1002/1003/1006), focus (1004), paste (2004) and 7700 reporting at once. In new mode it prints a ready line, waits for one key, then turns reporting on by its own output. Every launch is numbered and its raw input is written to input-N.bin. The daemon runs with --restore-workspace and is restarted with `pmux restart --daemon --stop-sessions`.
observed: before restart: a pointer click over the old child's pane reached it as SGR reports (input-5: ESC [ < 35;19;13 M, ESC [ < 0;19;13 M, ESC [ < 0;19;13 m)
after the daemon restart the Space's session was restored with its saved screen text kept and a replacement child (launch 6, not opted in) running in the same pane
pointer clicks over the replacement pane before it opted in delivered 0 bytes to it (input-6 empty), so no stale mouse reporting reached the new child

after the replacement received one key and turned reporting on itself, the same pointer clicks reached it as SGR reports (input-6: e, then ESC [ < 35;19;13 M and the rest), so the reset does not block a child that opts in again
